newsitem.title: INDIA: India ACC unit, ShinMaywa tie up.
newsitem.headline: India ACC unit, ShinMaywa tie up.

text.p: India's ACC Machinery Co Ltd (AMCL) said it signed a technical collaboration agreement with ShinMaywa Industries Ltd of Japan to manufacture bulk carriers to transport flyash and cement.
AMCL is a wholly-owned subdidiary of India's largest cement maker Associated Cement Companies.

ShinMaywa's truck division, with which AMCL is collaborating, specialises in manufacture of a range of dump truck bodies, tipping gears, concrete mixers, tankers, container trucks, loading and unloading vehicles, an AMCL statement said.
ShinMaywa equipment will be manufactured at AMCL's workshop in Butibori near Nagpur in central India, it said.
